criteria.description: [R1] `from app_int.main import round_currency` succeeds and `round_currency` is callable.
[R2] round_currency returns a value with at most 2 decimal places for any of the example inputs, e.g. round_currency(3.14159) equals 3.14 numerically.

[R3] Round-half-up on exact halves: round_currency(2.345) == 2.35, round_currency(2.335) == 2.34, round_currency(0.005) == 0.01, round_currency(1.005) == 1.01 (numeric comparison). round_currency(2.345) must NOT equal 2.34 (banker's rounding result).
[R4] Negative halves round away from zero: round_currency(-2.345) == -2.35 and round_currency(-0.005) == -0.01 (numeric comparison).
[R5] Non-half values round to nearest: round_currency(2.344) == 2.34, round_currency(2.346) == 2.35, round_currency(-2.344) == -2.34 (numeric comparison).
[R6] Values with 2 or fewer decimals are unchanged: round_currency(10) == 10.00, round_currency(2.5) == 2.50, round_currency(0) == 0.00, round_currency(19.99) == 19.99 (numeric comparison).
[R7] round_currency.__doc__ is non-empty and explicitly names the rounding mode as round-half-up (half away from zero) and 2 decimal places.
[R8] health_check() still returns {"status": "ok"} and add(2, 3) still returns 5; all pre-existing tests in tests/ pass unmodified.
[R9] `uv run pytest -q` exits 0 and `uv run ruff check .` exits 0 on the final branch.
[R10] The [project] dependencies list in pyproject.toml is unchanged compared with the base branch.
